svg.text: 53 nodes · 61 relationships · 44 implied labels, generated from the AAS metamodel 3.2 RDF ontology and SHACL shapes (GitHub admin-shell-io/aas-specs-metamodel, tag v3.2.0). The main arrows are named by their relationship type; hover any arrow for its name and description, and cards link to the class in the AAS specification.
Core — shells, assets, submodels and concept descriptions
Common attributes, references and language strings
Data specifications (IEC 61360 and units of measure)
a model reference resolved to its element
subtype: also carries the supertype's label

path.title: HAS_CREATOR: The subject ID of the subject responsible for making the element. Each AdministrativeInformation has at most one Reference. A composition: each Reference is part of at most one owner.

HAS_ANNOTATIONS: A data element that represents an annotation that holds for the relationship between the two elements. Each AnnotatedRelationshipElement has zero or more DataElement. A composition: each DataElement is part of at most one owner.

HAS_ASSET_INFORMATION: Meta-information about the asset the AAS is representing. Each AssetAdministrationShell has exactly one AssetInformation. A composition: each AssetInformation is part of at most one owner.
HAS_DERIVED_FROM: The reference to the AAS the AAS was derived from. Each AssetAdministrationShell has at most one Reference. A composition: each Reference is part of at most one owner.
HAS_SUBMODELS: References to submodels of the AAS. Each AssetAdministrationShell has zero or more Reference. A composition: each Reference is part of at most one owner.
HAS_DEFAULT_THUMBNAIL: Thumbnail of the asset represented by the Asset Administration Shell. Each AssetInformation has at most one Resource. A composition: each Resource is part of at most one owner.

HAS_SPECIFIC_ASSET_IDS: Additional domain-specific, typically proprietary identifier for the asset like e.g., serial number etc. Each AssetInformation has zero or more SpecificAssetId. A composition: each SpecificAssetId is part of at most one owner.

HAS_MESSAGE_BROKER: Information, which outer message infrastructure shall handle messages for the 'EventElement'. Refers to a 'Submodel', 'SubmodelElementList', 'SubmodelElementCollection' or 'Entity', which contains 'DataElement''s describing the proprietary specification for the message broker. Each BasicEventElement has at most one Reference. A composition: each Reference is part of at most one owner.

HAS_OBSERVED: Reference to the 'Referable', which defines the scope of the event. Can be 'AssetAdministrationShell', 'Submodel', or 'SubmodelElement'. Each BasicEventElement has exactly one Reference. A composition: each Reference is part of at most one owner.

IS_CASE_OF: Reference to an external definition the concept is compatible to or was derived from. Each ConceptDescription has zero or more Reference. A composition: each Reference is part of at most one owner.

HAS_DEFINITION: Definition in different languages. Each DataSpecificationIec61360 has zero or more LangStringDefinitionTypeIec61360. A composition: each LangStringDefinitionTypeIec61360 is part of at most one owner.
HAS_LEVEL_TYPE: Set of levels. Each DataSpecificationIec61360 has at most one LevelType. A composition: each LevelType is part of at most one owner.

HAS_PREFERRED_NAME: Preferred name. Each DataSpecificationIec61360 has one or more LangStringPreferredNameTypeIec61360. A composition: each LangStringPreferredNameTypeIec61360 is part of at most one owner.
HAS_SHORT_NAME: Short name. Each DataSpecificationIec61360 has zero or more LangStringShortNameTypeIec61360. A composition: each LangStringShortNameTypeIec61360 is part of at most one owner.
HAS_UNIT_ID: Unique unit id. Each DataSpecificationIec61360 has at most one Reference. A composition: each Reference is part of at most one owner.
HAS_VALUE_LIST: List of allowed values. Each DataSpecificationIec61360 has at most one ValueList. A composition: each ValueList is part of at most one owner.

HAS_DEFINITION: Definition of the unit in different languages. Each DataSpecificationUom has zero or more LangStringDefinitionTypeUom. A composition: each LangStringDefinitionTypeUom is part of at most one owner.

HAS_PREFERRED_NAME: Preferred name of the unit in different languages as defined by the classification system. Each DataSpecificationUom has one or more LangStringUom. A composition: each LangStringUom is part of at most one owner.

HAS_PREFERRED_NAME_QUANTITY: Preferred name of the unit's quantity in different languages. Each DataSpecificationUom has zero or more LangStringUom. A composition: each LangStringUom is part of at most one owner.
HAS_DATA_SPECIFICATION: Reference to the data specification. Each EmbeddedDataSpecification has exactly one Reference. A composition: each Reference is part of at most one owner.

HAS_DATA_SPECIFICATION_CONTENT: Actual content of the data specification. Each EmbeddedDataSpecification has exactly one DataSpecificationContent. A composition: each DataSpecificationContent is part of at most one owner.

HAS_SPECIFIC_ASSET_IDS: Reference to a specific asset ID representing a supplementary identifier of the asset represented by the Asset Administration Shell. Each Entity has zero or more SpecificAssetId. A composition: each SpecificAssetId is part of at most one owner.

HAS_STATEMENTS: Describes statements applicable to the entity by a set of submodel elements, typically with a qualified value. Each Entity has zero or more SubmodelElement. A composition: each SubmodelElement is part of at most one owner.
HAS_ASSET_ADMINISTRATION_SHELLS: Asset administration shell. Each Environment has zero or more AssetAdministrationShell. A composition: each AssetAdministrationShell is part of at most one owner.
HAS_CONCEPT_DESCRIPTIONS: Concept description. Each Environment has zero or more ConceptDescription. A composition: each ConceptDescription is part of at most one owner.
HAS_SUBMODELS: Submodel. Each Environment has zero or more Submodel. A composition: each Submodel is part of at most one owner.
HAS_OBSERVABLE_REFERENCE: Reference to the referable, which defines the scope of the event. Each EventPayload has exactly one Reference. A composition: each Reference is part of at most one owner.

HAS_OBSERVABLE_SEMANTIC_ID: 'semanticId' of the referable which defines the scope of the event, if available. Each EventPayload has at most one Reference. A composition: each Reference is part of at most one owner.

HAS_SOURCE: Reference to the source event element, including identification of 'AssetAdministrationShell', 'Submodel', 'SubmodelElement''s. Each EventPayload has exactly one Reference. A composition: each Reference is part of at most one owner.
HAS_SOURCE_SEMANTIC_ID: 'semanticId' of the source event element, if available. Each EventPayload has at most one Reference. A composition: each Reference is part of at most one owner.
HAS_SUBJECT_ID: Subject, who/which initiated the creation. Each EventPayload has at most one Reference. A composition: each Reference is part of at most one owner.
REFERS_TO: Reference to an element the extension refers to. Each Extension has zero or more Reference. A composition: each Reference is part of at most one owner.

HAS_EMBEDDED_DATA_SPECIFICATIONS: Embedded data specification. Each HasDataSpecification has zero or more EmbeddedDataSpecification. A composition: each EmbeddedDataSpecification is part of at most one owner.
HAS_EXTENSIONS: An extension of the element. Each HasExtensions has zero or more Extension. A composition: each Extension is part of at most one owner.

HAS_SEMANTIC_ID: Identifier of the semantic definition of the element. It is called semantic ID of the element or also main semantic ID of the element. Each HasSemantics has at most one Reference. A composition: each Reference is part of at most one owner.

HAS_SUPPLEMENTAL_SEMANTIC_IDS: Identifier of a supplemental semantic definition of the element. It is called supplemental semantic ID of the element. Each HasSemantics has zero or more Reference. A composition: each Reference is part of at most one owner.

HAS_ADMINISTRATION: Administrative information of an identifiable element. Each Identifiable has at most one AdministrativeInformation. A composition: each AdministrativeInformation is part of at most one owner.
HAS_VALUE: The value of the property instance. Each MultiLanguageProperty has zero or more LangStringTextType. A composition: each LangStringTextType is part of at most one owner.
HAS_VALUE_ID: Reference to the global unique ID of a coded value. Each MultiLanguageProperty has at most one Reference. A composition: each Reference is part of at most one owner.
HAS_INOUTPUT_VARIABLES: Parameter that is input and output of the operation. Each Operation has zero or more OperationVariable. A composition: each OperationVariable is part of at most one owner.
HAS_INPUT_VARIABLES: Input parameter of the operation. Each Operation has zero or more OperationVariable. A composition: each OperationVariable is part of at most one owner.
HAS_OUTPUT_VARIABLES: Output parameter of the operation. Each Operation has zero or more OperationVariable. A composition: each OperationVariable is part of at most one owner.

HAS_VALUE: Describes an argument or result of an operation via a submodel element. Each OperationVariable has exactly one SubmodelElement. A composition: each SubmodelElement is part of at most one owner.
HAS_VALUE_ID: Reference to the global unique ID of a coded value. Each Property has at most one Reference. A composition: each Reference is part of at most one owner.
HAS_QUALIFIERS: Additional qualification of a qualifiable element. Each Qualifiable has zero or more Qualifier. A composition: each Qualifier is part of at most one owner.
HAS_VALUE_ID: Reference to the global unique ID of a coded value. Each Qualifier has at most one Reference. A composition: each Reference is part of at most one owner.
HAS_DESCRIPTION: Description or comments on the element. Each Referable has zero or more LangStringTextType. A composition: each LangStringTextType is part of at most one owner.
HAS_DISPLAY_NAME: Display name. Can be provided in several languages. Each Referable has zero or more LangStringNameType. A composition: each LangStringNameType is part of at most one owner.
HAS_KEYS: Unique references in their name space. Each Reference has one or more Key. A composition: each Key is part of at most one owner. The list is ordered, by the index property.

HAS_REFERRED_SEMANTIC_ID: 'semanticId' of the referenced model element ('type' = 'ModelReference'). Each Reference has at most one Reference. A composition: each Reference is part of at most one owner.

HAS_VALUE: Global reference to an external object or entity or a logical reference to another element within the same or another AAS (i.e. a model reference to a Referable). Each ReferenceElement has at most one Reference. A composition: each Reference is part of at most one owner.

HAS_FIRST: Reference to the first element in the relationship taking the role of the subject. Each RelationshipElement has at most one Reference. A composition: each Reference is part of at most one owner.

HAS_SECOND: Reference to the second element in the relationship taking the role of the object. Each RelationshipElement has at most one Reference. A composition: each Reference is part of at most one owner.
HAS_EXTERNAL_SUBJECT_ID: The (external) subject the key belongs to or has meaning to. Each SpecificAssetId has at most one Reference. A composition: each Reference is part of at most one owner.
HAS_SUBMODEL_ELEMENTS: A submodel consists of zero or more submodel elements. Each Submodel has zero or more SubmodelElement. A composition: each SubmodelElement is part of at most one owner.
HAS_VALUE: Submodel element contained in the collection. Each SubmodelElementCollection has zero or more SubmodelElement. A composition: each SubmodelElement is part of at most one owner.

HAS_SEMANTIC_ID_LIST_ELEMENT: Semantic ID the submodel elements contained in the list match to. Each SubmodelElementList has at most one Reference. A composition: each Reference is part of at most one owner.

HAS_VALUE: Submodel element contained in the list. Each SubmodelElementList has zero or more SubmodelElement. A composition: each SubmodelElement is part of at most one owner. The list is ordered, by the index property.

HAS_VALUE_REFERENCE_PAIRS: A pair of a value together with its global unique id. Each ValueList has one or more ValueReferencePair. A composition: each ValueReferencePair is part of at most one owner.
HAS_VALUE_ID: Global unique id of the value. Each ValueReferencePair has at most one Reference. A composition: each Reference is part of at most one owner.

RESOLVES_TO: The element a model reference identifies, resolved from its keys: the Identifiable its first key names, and the Referable the following keys name within it. Not part of the AAS metamodel: added by the ontology, so that references can be followed in the graph. Each Reference has at most one; an external reference, or a model reference to an element outside the graph, has none.
Every AdministrativeInformation is also a HasDataSpecification
Every AnnotatedRelationshipElement is also a RelationshipElement
Every AssetAdministrationShell is also a Identifiable
Every AssetAdministrationShell is also a HasDataSpecification
Every BasicEventElement is also a EventElement
Every Blob is also a DataElement
Every Capability is also a SubmodelElement
Every ConceptDescription is also a Identifiable
Every ConceptDescription is also a HasDataSpecification
Every DataElement is also a SubmodelElement
Every DataSpecificationIec61360 is also a DataSpecificationContent
Every DataSpecificationUom is also a DataSpecificationContent
Every Entity is also a SubmodelElement
Every EventElement is also a SubmodelElement
Every Extension is also a HasSemantics
Every File is also a DataElement
Every Identifiable is also a Referable
Every LangStringDefinitionTypeIec61360 is also a AbstractLangString
Every LangStringDefinitionTypeUom is also a AbstractLangString
Every LangStringNameType is also a AbstractLangString
Every LangStringPreferredNameTypeIec61360 is also a AbstractLangString
Every LangStringShortNameTypeIec61360 is also a AbstractLangString
Every LangStringTextType is also a AbstractLangString
Every LangStringUom is also a AbstractLangString
Every MultiLanguageProperty is also a DataElement
Every Operation is also a SubmodelElement
Every Property is also a DataElement
Every Qualifier is also a HasSemantics
Every Range is also a DataElement
Every Referable is also a HasExtensions
Every ReferenceElement is also a DataElement
Every RelationshipElement is also a SubmodelElement
Every SpecificAssetId is also a HasSemantics
Every Submodel is also a Identifiable
Every Submodel is also a HasKind
Every Submodel is also a HasSemantics
Every Submodel is also a Qualifiable
Every Submodel is also a HasDataSpecification
Every SubmodelElement is also a Referable
Every SubmodelElement is also a HasSemantics
Every SubmodelElement is also a Qualifiable
Every SubmodelElement is also a HasDataSpecification
Every SubmodelElementCollection is also a SubmodelElement
Every SubmodelElementList is also a SubmodelElement

g.title: AbstractLangString — Strings with language tags. Properties: uid, language, text
AdministrativeInformation — Administrative meta-information for an element like version information. Properties: uid, version, revision, createdAt, updatedAt, templateId
AnnotatedRelationshipElement — An annotated relationship element is a relationship element that can be annotated with additional data elements. Properties: uid
AssetAdministrationShell — An asset administration shell. Properties: uid
AssetInformation — In 'AssetInformation' identifying meta data of the asset that is represented by an AAS is defined. Properties: uid, assetKind, globalAssetId, assetType
BasicEventElement — A basic event element. Properties: uid, direction, state, messageTopic, lastUpdate, minInterval, maxInterval
Blob — A 'Blob' is a data element that represents a file that is contained with its source code in the value attribute. Properties: uid, value, contentType
Capability — A capability is the implementation-independent description of the potential of an asset to achieve a certain effect in the physical or virtual world. Properties: uid
ConceptDescription — The semantics of a property or other elements that may have a semantic description is defined by a concept description. Properties: uid
DataElement — A data element is a submodel element that is not further composed out of other submodel elements. Properties: uid

DataSpecificationContent — Data specification content is part of a data specification template and defines which additional attributes shall be added to the element instance that references the data specification template and meta information about the template itself. Properties: uid

DataSpecificationIec61360 — Content of data specification template for concept descriptions for properties, values and value lists conformant to IEC 61360. Properties: uid, unit, sourceOfDefinition, symbol, dataType, valueFormat, value

DataSpecificationUom — Content of data specification template for concept descriptions for Units of Measurement. Properties: uid, symbol, specificUnitId, quantityId, classificationSystem, classificationSystemVersion
EmbeddedDataSpecification — Embed the content of a data specification. Properties: uid
Entity — An entity is a submodel element that is used to model entities. Properties: uid, entityType, globalAssetId
Environment — Container for the sets of different identifiables. Properties: uid
EventElement — An event element. Properties: uid
EventPayload — Defines the necessary information of an event instance sent out or received. Properties: uid, topic, timeStamp, payload
Extension — Single extension of an element. Properties: uid, name, valueType, value
File — A File is a data element that represents an address to a file (a locator). Properties: uid, value, contentType
HasDataSpecification — Element that can be extended by using data specification templates. Properties: uid
HasExtensions — Element that can be extended by proprietary extensions. Properties: uid
HasKind — An element with a kind is an element that can either represent a template or an instance. Properties: uid, kind
HasSemantics — Element that can have a semantic definition plus some supplemental semantic definitions. Properties: uid
Identifiable — An element that has a globally unique identifier. Properties: uid, id
Key — A key is a reference to an element by its ID. Properties: uid, type, value
LangStringDefinitionTypeIec61360 — String with length 1023 maximum and minimum 1 characters and with language tags. Properties: uid, text
LangStringDefinitionTypeUom — Definition string with language tag, maximum length 2048 and minimum length 1. Properties: uid, text
LangStringNameType — String with length 128 maximum and minimum 1 characters and with language tags. Properties: uid, text
LangStringPreferredNameTypeIec61360 — String with length 255 maximum and minimum 1 characters and with language tags. Properties: uid, text
LangStringShortNameTypeIec61360 — String with length 18 maximum and minimum 1 characters and with language tags. Properties: uid, text
LangStringTextType — String with length 1023 maximum and minimum 1 characters and with language tags. Properties: uid, text
LangStringUom — String with language tag, maximum length 256 and minimum length 1. Properties: uid, text

LevelType — Value represented by up to four variants of a numeric value in a specific role: MIN, NOM, TYP and MAX. True means that the value is available, false means the value is not available. Properties: uid, min, nom, typ, max
MultiLanguageProperty — A property is a data element that has a multi-language value. Properties: uid
Operation — An operation is a submodel element with input and output variables. Properties: uid
OperationVariable — The value of an operation variable is a submodel element that is used as input and/or output variable of an operation. Properties: uid
Property — A property is a data element that has a single value. Properties: uid, valueType, value
Qualifiable — The value of a qualifiable element may be further qualified by one or more qualifiers. Properties: uid
Qualifier — A qualifier is a type-value-pair that makes additional statements w.r.t. the value of the element. Properties: uid, kind, type, valueType, value
Range — A range data element is a data element that defines a range with min and max. Properties: uid, valueType, min, max
Referable — An element that is referable by its 'idShort'. Properties: uid, category, idShort
Reference — Reference to either a model element of the same or another AAS or to an external entity. Properties: uid, type

ReferenceElement — A reference element is a data element that defines a logical reference to another element within the same or another AAS or a reference to an external object or entity. Properties: uid
RelationshipElement — A relationship element is used to define a relationship between two elements being either referable (model reference) or external (global reference). Properties: uid
Resource — Resource represents an address to a file (a locator). The value is an URI that can represent an absolute or relative path. Properties: uid, path, contentType
SpecificAssetId — A specific asset ID describes a generic supplementary identifying attribute of the asset. Properties: uid, name, value
Submodel — A submodel defines a specific aspect of the asset represented by the AAS. Properties: uid
SubmodelElement — A submodel element is an element suitable for the description and differentiation of assets. Properties: uid
SubmodelElementCollection — A submodel element collection is a kind of struct, i.e. a a logical encapsulation of multiple named values. It has a fixed number of submodel elements. Properties: uid
SubmodelElementList — A submodel element list is an ordered list of submodel elements. Properties: uid, orderRelevant, typeValueListElement, valueTypeListElement
ValueList — A set of value reference pairs. Properties: uid
ValueReferencePair — A value reference pair within a value list. Each value has a global unique id defining its semantic. Properties: uid, value
